FINDINGS: Three distinct lessons from one discovery.

teaching_levels.title: What is a Gemini managed agent? Clean a CSV in AI Studio (no code)
teaching_levels.question: What is this and how do I use it?
teaching_levels.promise: Use an AI Studio agent template to clean a file and download the result.
teaching_levels.demo: steps 1-6 of the plan, no Python
teaching_levels.outcome: a cleaned CSV and a plain-English idea of what a sandbox is
teaching_levels.value_statement: After this you can use an AI Studio agent template to clean a messy CSV without writing code.

teaching_levels.title: Automate a weekly file clean-up with the Gemini Interactions API
teaching_levels.question: How can I use this to solve a real problem?
teaching_levels.promise: Script the same job in Python and keep working in one sandbox across requests.
teaching_levels.outcome: a reusable Python script that uploads, cleans, charts and downloads
teaching_levels.value_statement: After this you can run a managed agent from Python and reuse its sandbox with the environment id.

teaching_levels.title: A production-shaped file agent: Files API, Credentials API and scheduled runs
teaching_levels.question: How can I build a serious workflow/system with this?
teaching_levels.promise: Design a scheduled job that feeds exports to the agent, stores results, and uses registered credentials for a connected service.
teaching_levels.demo: architecture sketch, credential registration, a scheduled run, failure handling
teaching_levels.outcome: a runnable design with secrets kept out of prompts
teaching_levels.value_statement: After this you can design a scheduled file-processing agent that keeps secrets out of the prompt using the Credentials API.

Gemini managed agents: give it a file, get a better file back
The one setting that keeps your files between Gemini agent requests
production.description: Google updated Gemini API managed agents (antigravity-preview-09-2026) and added a Files API and a Credentials API. In this tutorial you give an agent a messy spreadsheet in AI Studio, watch it clean the data in its own sandbox, download the result, then do the same from Python and keep working in the same sandbox with the environment ID. Caveats: preview service; check pricing and free-tier limits; never paste keys into prompts.
